troubleshooting.title: Cannot Install from the Update Site
troubleshooting.shortdesc: If cannot reach the update site, install from a downloaded package instead.

condition.title: Problem
condition.p: The add-on does not install, and the update-site URL cannot be reached.

cause.title: Cause
cause.p: A network restriction or proxy is blocking the connection to the update site.

step.cmd: Download the add-on package and unzip it.
In HelpInstall new add-ons, select Browse for local files and choose the addon.xml file from the unzipped package.
